contentCheck.notes: Crop shows stem, electrolysis cell diagram, reduction-potential table and parts (a)-(c); matches page context. Page footer says GO ON TO THE NEXT PAGE, so a later part may exist on another page; catalog lists only a-c.

primary.evidence: Must recognize Cl- is oxidized at the electrode producing Cl2 and Li+ reduced at the electrode producing Li, so electrons flow in the wire from the Cl2 electrode to the Li electrode.
Must reverse the Cl2 half-reaction and double the Li+ half-reaction so electrons cancel, giving 2 Li+ + 2 Cl- -> 2 Li + Cl2.
Must convert 0.18 g Li to moles of electrons (1 e- per Li) and use the Faraday constant and I = q/t over 3200 s to find the current.

uncertainty: Possible continuation page (footer 'GO ON TO THE NEXT PAGE') not included; only parts a-c could be checked.
